pathways.climate_pressure: Flood and other climate hazards creating displacement risk.
pathways.documented_impact: Loss of housing/livelihood stability and disruption of social/economic/legal protections.
pathways.fcv_mediator: Recognition, service access and protection gaps can limit safe coping and fair allocation during displacement.
pathways.possible_consequence: The ISIS authors warn of escalating resource competition and tensions with host communities or the state; no measured violence outcome.
alternative_explanations: Pre-existing inequality, tenure rules, service investment, urban development and wider political/economic conditions also affect displacement and social relations.
pathways.uncertainty: Conditional national policy analysis, not local incident evidence or causal evaluation. Legal-protection claims are attributed to the authors, not current legal advice; no displaced-group threat label.
resilience_factors: The CCDR recommends targeted housing/livelihood/financial support and inclusive planning; delivery and peace effects are not established.
pathways.compact_statement: The 2026 ISIS note warns that climate-related displacement can weaken protective systems and, where recognition/services are inadequate, aggravate resource tensions; this is conditional policy analysis, not observed climate-caused violence.

gaps: The policy note's legal-protection framing is attributed to its authors and date, not adopted as a comprehensive current legal finding.
Customary tenure, coordination and trust constraints are relevant governance mediators but do not establish armed conflict or an observed insecurity blockage to adaptation.

executive_assessment.text: The 2026 CCDR identifies named districts where flood exposure overlaps poverty, with Sabah/Sarawak tenure, monitoring and institutional-coordination constraints adding subnational depth.

The ISIS note describes a conditional displacement/protection–resource-tension mechanism, not measured climate-caused violence. Adaptation recommendations and national-plan development are not verified delivery.
